GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic/export revenue split: NOT retrieved — the financials page returned HTTP 404 and screener.in returned HTTP 404, so exact revenue and domestic turnover figures are null (not public in what was accessible).
note: Name mismatch resolved: 'BIRLA TEXTILE MILLS' is not a separate legal entity in the records found; the operating entity behind the Birla textile business is SUTLEJ TEXTILES AND INDUSTRIES LIMITED (promoted by the late Dr. Krishna Kumar Birla), which is the name that appears in customs records. HS discrepancy: declared HS 520839 (woven cotton, <200 g/m2, printed) does NOT match the actual shipment HS 54078290 (woven fabrics of synthetic filament yarn, dyed, mixed with cotton) seen in every visible row — per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground; the code should be corrected to the factual 54078290 (with 5208xx possible for the cotton-blend yarn line). Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is wrong — actual industry is textiles (yarn, home textiles, recycled/green fibre). State claim Himachal Pradesh is not supported by the records seen (customs address 'PACHPAHAR ROAD', corporate office Mumbai, Maharashtra); Himachal units not verified. PAN AAJCS1850N not verified against any public source in this session — treat as unconfirmed. Export status CONFIRMED on real customs rows with dates, destinations, HS and B/L numbers (USA, UK, plus Bangladesh/Chittagong lanes). Domestic status CONFIRMED as an operating manufacturer with inbound supply chains, but GST turnover band and tender/contract evidence were not retrievable, so revenue and domestic turnover are null. No grounds for rejection.
